_comment: The loop's baseline, decided by R3 on 2026-09-05 and re-affirmed 2026-09-06 on the refereed R1 pass-4 / R2 pass-3 inputs (research/g212_baseline_verdict.md; every figure asserted by research/g212_trace.py). Fields documented in research/tape/README.md. REBUILD PIN: L5 (350b02fc) flipped signal_runner.DAY_POLICY's default to 3fires_stop_win_or_2loss, so a bare `python backtest_2y.py --days 730` at HEAD builds book_id 205d3dcee96c5282 (= book_DAY_POLICY_on), not this baseline. rebuild.env pins DAY_POLICY=first3, which reproduces book_id 2c39ced2697c26cc byte-identically at a later commit (book_DAY_POLICY_off, 5e8b5b89) and again at 24b009e5 on 2026-09-06 (rebuild.reproduced_at). loop_cycle.py's OFF arm strips only the flag under test, so the pin survives every cycle; a cycle that tests DAY_POLICY itself is already done (cycle 5) and must not be re-run through this config. WINDOW: backtest_2y.py --days counts back from the LAST ARCHIVED session and research/daily_fetch.py advances data_archive/ every weekday at 16:15 ET; the archive's last session is 2026-09-04, so the rebuild reproduces this window until the archive next advances (2026-09-08 16:15 ET at the earliest, 09-07 is a holiday). After that the OFF arm cannot match this book_id without a --start/--end pin in backtest_2y.py, an engine change no R3 pass owns.
exit: shipped engine: 1R hard stop filled on the intrabar touch (DISASTER_STOP_R=1.0 resting on the level), SCALE_PLAN=hod_then_runner_be, LOSS_HALT on

rebuild.engine_env_at_build: none set at 29e4abc6 (DAY_POLICY's default was first3 then); every other flag at its shipped default; the phantom column is the same command with ENTRY_FILL=published

reproduced_at.how: the command above, in the background, book_id recomputed by research/book_stamp.book_id

baseline_figures._unit: up_to_3_stop_win_or_2loss on core11, honest close fill, research/g212_trace.py

phantom_figures._unit: same unit, same slice, ENTRY_FILL=published -- a side-by-side column, never a target
